content:
marco: Heads up — after the 09:00 UTC rollout (release-3.1.0) EU embed requests p95 jumped from 140ms -> 1.2s. Seen in eu-1 and eu-2. Link: https://dash.redwood.ai/embeds/eu. Deployed 7m ago. Any quick mitigation?

deploybot: deploybot: Alert: embeddings.p95@eu > 1s. Autorevert policy: enabled but currently blocked by change-window (legal-review). Suggested: targeted traffic split or temporary pin.

tasha: oncall: initial traces show increased kv cache thrashing + larger batches from partner-tenant "acme". Could be client side change amplifying backend kv pressure.

leo: if it's tenant-driven, we can route that tenant to a safe path first. Example command: `redwood route update --tenant acme --route embeddings --to release-3.0.5` (dry-run available).

maria: we don't want a full rollback while change-window/legal is open. Ops: can we do per-tenant routing + short pin for EU to reduce impact?

ops-lead: agree with per-tenant routing first. If broader traffic remains degraded after 12m, we'll schedule a controlled rollback at 23:30 UTC tonight (outside change-window) unless legal forces different timing. Marco, please apply the tenant route and a 30m pin for eu region.

marco: applying commands now: `redwood route update --tenant acme --route embeddings --to release-3.0.5 --force` then `redwood pin set --region eu --route embeddings --version release-3.0.5 --duration 30m`

deploybot: deploybot: Tenant route applied for acme at 2026-03-14T09:16:12Z. Region pin applied for eu embeddings by marco at 2026-03-14T09:16:35Z. Observing.

tasha: pinned region p95 dropped to ~150ms in EU test slice. acme tenant now ~120ms. Good. I'll notify CS to pause their active troubleshooting with the customer.

julian: creating ticket INF-5678: "EU embeddings p95 regression after 3.1.0 1 tenant reroute + regional pin applied" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5678. Adding traces and sample logs.

maria: can we capture the exact deploy diff to link to release notes? Might help parity with legal. `git rev-parse --short HEAD` -> `a1b2c3d` (from deploy manifest).

ops-lead: comms: short customer blurb for CS + Sales: "We observed elevated latency for some EU embedding requests following a recent release. We routed affected traffic to a prior stable version and expect normal latency to resume for impacted customers. No data loss. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline." Tasha, please send.

tasha: will send now. Also cc legal with the facts-only blurb.

marco: monitoring 10m. If things hold, we'll lift the pin after 30m and then plan a night rollback if we confirm a regression tied to the new kv cache heuristic.

deploybot: deploybot: Autorevert suppressed due to legal change-window; no automatic rollback will run. Manual rollback scheduled only.

julian: note for postmortem: include tenant-side request size histogram and server-side batch distribution. Quick log snippet I saved: `WARN kv_cache.go:237 miss_rate=0.48 batch_len=24 tenant=acme`

ops-lead: final decision: immediate remediation = per-tenant reroute + eu regional 30m pin. Follow-up action = if p95 stays >300ms for >12m after pin expires, perform full region rollback to release-3.0.5 during 23:30 UTC window; prepare customer notification and release-note update. Assign owners: Marco (exec pin/reroute), Tasha (customer comms), Julian (ticket & logs), Maria (release diff).

marco: done. I'll post a short debrief in INF-5678 once we check the 30m window.

tasha: customer note sent to CS & Sales.

julian: INF-5678 updated with traces and next steps.

marco: thanks all. Keeping thread active until ticket resolved.
